test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A # B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

A & B means ‘A is the husband of B’

A % B means ‘A is the father of B’

If A % B & C # D @ E, then how is B related to E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

**Given :**

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 %
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Husband

 
 Father
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Statement given : **A % B & C # D @ E**

**Explanation :**

 
• A % B → A is the father of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75dfa4901f6cf554600585d1e43b2e01525f93455373615421c8c94c057e02bb.png] ​

 
• B & C → B is the husband of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14d9c82dcb3261bc4839fb369581ebcb8531c10df8bb5d2163918eaa5c55a24f.png] ​

 
• C # D → C is the sister of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/695dd922e049986d8b0577bd8ea790a9cebea8e3c9f1408bd4aad074c4834c2f.png] ​

 
• D @ E → D is the daughter of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f993c9938577bac89f8711af3df8123631d341ee38ee0b2f684f0eaf43bb8534.png] ​

Thus, from the final family tree B is the son-in-law of E.

Hence, "**Son-in-law**" is the correct answer.
